policies.name: Spec impact
policies.description: A milestone that changes a public contract names its owning specification.
ac: A milestone that changes a contract MUST list its owner under Related Files; one that changes none MUST list no spec path.

policies.name: No default bound
policies.description: Nothing may supply a tolerance, a device, a dtype or an extent that the caller did not state.
ac: A change MUST NOT introduce a default tolerance, a fallback device document, or a guessed extent. An unknown input is refused with what is installed, not filled in.

policies.name: Milestone review
policies.description: Touched tests retain only meaningful contract coverage after each milestone.
ac: Touched tests MUST be reviewed for redundancy: remove ones superseded by the retained workflow, and do not add source-shape or hypothetical-refactor guards unless that form is a public contract.
